_comment_backbone: SwinV2-L replaced by the plain VGG16 of SplineCNN/DGMC (relu4_2 + relu5_1 = 512 + 512 channels, 512-d global vector), so NMT becomes comparable to DGMC-scale graph matching models. IMAGE_SIZE 256 is the DGMC/ThinkMatch setting and also rescales the edge pseudo-coordinates in utils/build_graphs.py.

TRAIN._comment_epochs: lr_schedule long_halving5 defines 12 epochs; max_epochs stops after 7. NMT trains ~11 epochs per day, so 7 epochs is ~15.3 h. Both LR drops (epochs 2 and 5) still happen.
